```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
set.seed(9)
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  collect() |>
  slice_sample(n = 10)
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  summarize(
    avg_market_cap = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = coin_id
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_market_cap)) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")

crypto <- prices |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(
    categories |> rename(category_description = description),
    by = "category_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(date = ymd(date_raw))
```

```{r}
metadata |>
  select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date) |>
  print(n = 22)
```

```{r}
metadata <- metadata |>
  mutate(
    launched = coalesce(
      ymd(launch_date, quiet = TRUE),
      mdy(launch_date, quiet = TRUE)
    )
  )

metadata |>
  select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date, launched) |>
  arrange(launched) |>
  print(n = 22)
```

```{r}
prices |>
  filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  mutate(date = ymd(date_raw)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = price_usd)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Bitcoin Daily Price (USD)",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Price (USD)"
  )
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  summarize(
    market_cap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(date, category_name)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    category_name = fct_reorder(category_name, market_cap, .fun = mean, .desc = TRUE)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = market_cap, fill = category_name)) +
  geom_area(position = "fill") +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.Date(c("2022-05-09", "2022-11-09")),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = as.Date("2022-05-09"),
    y = 0.92,
    label = "Luna/UST Crash\n(May 2022)",
    color = "white",
    hjust = 1.05,
    size = 3,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = as.Date("2022-11-09"),
    y = 0.80,
    label = "FTX Collapse\n(Nov 2022)",
    color = "white",
    hjust = -0.05,
    size = 3,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  labs(
    title = "Bitcoin and Smart Contract Platforms Dominate Crypto Market Cap",
    subtitle = "Daily share of total cryptocurrency market capitalization by category (2018–2026)",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of Total Market Cap",
    fill = "Category",
    caption = "Source: CoinGecko / Course Crypto Dataset"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
